rules.title: Maximum security deposit limit
rules.quote: An owner or lessee may not require more than a sum equal to 1 1/2 times 1 month's rental according to the terms of contract, lease, or agreement as a security for the use or rental of real property used for dwelling purposes.
rules.summary: Landlords cannot require a security deposit of more than one and one-half months' rent for residential rental property.
rules.coverage_text: real property used for dwelling purposes
